messages:
ara: quick flag from the int8 onboarding smoke for minerva-v2: mixed CJK + RTL snippets are producing detached punctuation and token splits in beam outputs. sample below.
yong: paste the sample + tokenizer out?
ara: INPUT: "今日 \u05e9\u05dc\u05d5\u05dd: hello."
TOKENIZER: ["今", "日", " ", "\u05e9", "\u05dc", "\u05d5", "\u05dd", ":", " ", "hello", "."]
EXPECTED: ["今日", " ", "\u05e9\u05dc\u05d5\u05dd", ":", " ", "hello", "."]
eval-bot: run=id-602, model=minerva-v2-int8, dataset=locale-mix-small, metrics={bleu:-0.54}, anomalies={rtl_fragment:6, punct_detach:3}
rita: could be a preproc normalization or the tokenizer glue. we pushed a micro-change to control char stripping yesterday.
yong: i'll run a scoped bisect on the tokenizer commit range + compare token-id histograms against fp16. if histograms differ >1.5% for a sentence we'll fail the build.
ara: short-term mitigation: add a pre-token join rule for contiguous RTL clusters when adjacent to CJK; quick smoke shows BLEU recovers to -0.12.
rita: i'll open PR for preproc + add unit to locale-suite. also adding a nightly check for mixed-script token splits.
yong: started bisect; suspect commit is a tokenizer glue tweak. will post repro link shortly.
ara: tagging @support in case of customer hits. thanks all.
summary: minerva-v2 int8 onboarding: CJK+RTL punctuation detachment and token splits; short-term preproc join, bisect tokenizer glue, add histogram/regression tests
